annotations.title: One venture firm, person, fund or company in full

description: The full card for any entity on the venture graph: a firm (with recent investments, co-investors and funds), a person (with attributed investments and board seats), a fund (with all seven fund amounts kept apart and its lifecycle state) or a portfolio company (with its investors). Plus relationships, events, evidence and cross-graph links. Accepts dfx:vc: ids.

dfx_id.description: A DFX id: dfx:fo:<uuid> (family office graph), dfx:isi:<uuid> (sponsor graph), dfx:vc:<uuid> (venture graph), dfx:pe:<uuid> (private equity graph), dfx:ria:<uuid> (registered investment adviser graph), dfx:al:<uuid> (allocator graph), dfx:pc:<uuid> (private credit graph), dfx:ref:<uuid> (real estate fund graph), or a bare real estate UUID.
